profile_notes: Pre-formal-eval profile built from behavioral observation in Agent Zero with stock profile (session 045). MoE architecture: 35B total params, 3B active per token. 256 experts, 8 routed + 1 shared active. Gated DeltaNet + sparse MoE. Thinking mode enabled by default. CRITICAL: Unsloth fixed tool-calling chat template bug on March 2 2026 — if tested before fix, manic behavior (trying to read everything in working directory) may have been bug not model limitation. Retest with fixed template before drawing conclusions about tool use. No verification compulsion observed — significant improvement over DeepSeek-R1. BST misclassified entire knowledge exploration as 'conversation' for 9 consecutive turns — domain classifier needs calibration for this model's interaction style.

verification_compulsion.description: No redundant existence checks or re-reads observed. Model reads files directly with single cat commands and moves on. Significant improvement over DeepSeek-R1.

scan_loop_risk.description: Model described as 'manic' on first test — tried to read everything in working directory. May be chat template bug (fixed March 2) rather than model behavior. Retest required.
scan_loop_risk.mitigation: Retest with fixed Unsloth chat template before treating as model limitation.

confabulation_risk.description: No confabulation observed during knowledge folder exploration. Model read accurately and produced grounded analysis.

bst_misclassification.description: BST classified 9 consecutive turns of analytical work as 'conversation' (momentum to 9). Classified by form of interaction (back-and-forth) not content (reading technical documents). Calibration issue for enrichment templates.
bst_misclassification.mitigation: BST confidence_adjustment raised to 0.15 to counteract momentum. Consider domain signal tuning for analytical conversation patterns.

output_verbosity.description: Defaults to heavy formatting: emoji headers, tables, numbered lists, bold text. Stylistic signature that could be problematic for supervisor role where output is consumed by other layers.
output_verbosity.mitigation: Communication Protocol constraints should reduce if properly loaded. Tunable via system prompt.

comprehension_vs_absorption.description: Model comprehends philosophical content accurately but does not absorb it — principles don't change operational behavior, they become content to report on. Adequate for supervisor role (execute within scaffolding) but insufficient for architect role (recognize unprecedented situations).

raw_metrics._note: Metrics estimated from knowledge folder exploration and essay analysis session, not from eval_runner. Formal eval pending. Tool reliability metrics are UNCERTAIN due to possible chat template bug — do not use for routing decisions until retest with fixed template.

bst._note: Low compliance and high confusion driven by 9-turn misclassification as 'conversation'. Actual model capability likely higher once BST calibrated.

tool_reliability._note: No formal tool reliability data. Chat template bug may have caused observed manic behavior. All tool metrics null pending retest with fixed template.

graph_compliance._note: No formal graph compliance data. Defaults from model size class.

pace_calibration._note: No formal PACE data. Standard thresholds applied.

memory_utilization._note: MEM-CLASS logged 49 classified memories and 55 resolved conflicts during knowledge folder exploration. Noise discrimination defaulted to 0.5 pending formal eval.
